description: Record the user's money in DayHeart. add adds an operation: an expense (with a category by name, or Other), an income, or a loan (lent — the user gave money, borrowed — the user took money; with the person and a due date). Amounts are in the main currency. The same operation sent again within 10 minutes counts as a repeat of the request; two identical ones need different notes. update changes an operation: amount, date, note, category, expense or income, and for a loan the person, due date or returned.

amount.description: Amount in the main currency, e.g. 12.5

category.description: Expense category name, as in the user's categories; Other — no category

due.description: Loan: return by YYYY-MM-DD; empty string removes it

note.description: What it was, up to 200 characters

name: change_finance
title: Change finance
